pilot_runs.disclosure: The initial runner overwrote its output root. The aggregate value is retained from stdout, but this run is ineligible as evidence because its raw rows were not archived.

instability.diagnosis: Three process medians were insufficient under WSL2 scheduling noise; the median could still be controlled by an outlier and the point estimate was not repeatable.

revision.decision: Neither pilot is used as paper evidence.
changes: collect nine process medians per variant across three batches
scale inner iterations by workload FLOPs
pin a declared CPU and force common thread-count environment variables to one
gate claims on robust per-variant and cross-batch stability

protocol_dry_run.reason: The initial 3x5x5 configuration projected excessive process-initialization cost; it was stopped during the first batch before any aggregate was produced.
protocol_dry_run.effect_on_final_protocol: Independent batches were retained; process trials and within-process repeats were reduced to three before the confirmatory protocol was frozen.
